problems.explain: AB is a diameter, so ∠ACB stands on a semicircle, whose central angle is 180°: ∠ACB = 90°. The angles of △ABC add to 180°, so ∠CAB = 180 − 90 − 23 = 67°. (Without the right angle at C there would be nothing to go on.) So ∠CAB = 67°.
